messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing KV memory growth on runtime-gpu-7, p95 latency for longctx generation up ~120ms and token throughput drooping. looks like a tenant is pinning pages and blocking reuse :eyes:

luis: which tenant? any metrics or a dump?

maria: tenant=ztl-prod (org-ztl). KV residency went from ~8% -> 72% in ~10m on that host. quick dump:
```
tenant, pages_resident, pinned_pages
ztl-prod, 72000, 48000
acme, 12000, 2000
internal, 6000, 0
```

alex: wow, pinned_pages >> resident for ztl-prod. are these longctx streaming sessions keeping the KV pinned? profiler traces?

maria: yes — pattern is longctx streaming where sessions are created with keep-kv=true but the session finalizer isn't triggered when client disconnects early. KV entries become logically pinned and never available for reuse. stack traces point to streaming handler where on_error path skips session.close().

angela: mitigation idea: soft-eviction override for ztl-prod to force-release excess pinned pages and recycle stale sessions older than 30m. ops can we run that? :pray:

ken: started reclaim job: `./kvctl reclaim --tenant ztl-prod --force --max-release 30000`
ops-bot: reclaim job queued (id=job-9843) — progress logs will post here.

luis: for medium-term: we need eviction scoring that factors pinned_pages_ratio = pinned_pages / pages_resident, last_access_ms, and tenant_weight. if pinned_pages_ratio > 0.5 => aggressive reclaim. also add alert for pinned_pages_ratio > 0.35.

sophia: fragmentation is also a problem — even after reclaim the free spans are small and not reusable for longctx entries. propose a compaction pass to merge adjacent free slabs every hour, and track free_span_histogram.

maria: repro script located at /eng/runtime/tools/kv-leak-repro.sh — instructions: run 10 streaming clients with seq_len ~9k, random session disconnects. reliably reproduces residency climb to >70% in ~8-12m.

alex: opened PR to add soft-eviction canary and fix finalizer bug: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4421. will roll to 2 hosts with increased tracing first.

angela: action items: 1) ops: finish reclaim and confirm latency back to baseline, 2) eng-runtime: patch finalizer and add per-tenant pinned_pages alert, 3) infra: schedule compaction job design. assign to eng-runtime board.

maria: current status: reclaim job releasing 28k pages, p95 latency trending down to +30ms over baseline. will follow up with short incident note.

luis: long-term design notes: consider per-tenant watermarks + soft-cap enforcement (burst window) + eviction weight = f(pinned_ratio, last_access, tenant_quota) so noisy tenants can't starve others. add to roadmap.

sophia: logging suggestion: include tenant_id and pinned_delta in page-evict logs so we can attribute fragmentation/regrowth patterns per-tenant.

maria: thanks all. tagging @angela for rollout and @ken for reclaim confirmation. will post a short postmortem if it recurs. :white_check_mark:
